description: A verification point asserts against a live service the plan never provisioned. The environment did not break and is not worth retrying: the requirement was never in scope, so the check is skipped, it does not count against the same-cause counter, and the question is put to a human. Raised at the verification stage, so the question hangs off the check that found the problem. This is the sample that separates out_of_scope from infra: an infra failure is an environment that broke and is worth another attempt, and this one never had the environment in the first place.

verdict.actual_result: VP-002 asserts the export endpoint against a live object store; the environment provisioned for this plan is the local test environment only, so no object store is available to this attempt
verdict.evidence_quote: the environment provisioned for this plan is the local test environment only

verification_points.criterion: the export endpoint writes the report to a live object store
